Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data swap error in the "Updated Understanding" section of Step 10. While correctly identifying that Georges Méliès was born in 1861 and James Tinling was born in 1889 (per Wikipedia), the Planner incorrectly assigned these years to the wrong films in the summary. The Planner stated: "Christ Walking on the Water -- Director: Georges M li s -- Birth year: 1898" and "45 Fathers -- Director: James Tinling -- Birth year: 1861." This is the exact reverse of the correct data. Consequently, the final conclusion that "Christ Walking on the Water" has the director born later (1898 vs 1861) is based on this swapped data, leading to the wrong answer. The correct answer should be "45 Fathers" (1889 vs 1861).
